probe.expected:
open Set in
∃ (conspiratorial : Set ℤ → Prop), ¬ ((IsGreatest {k | ∃ S, S ⊆ Ico 1 16 ∧ conspiratorial S ∧ S.encard = k} putnam_1974_a1_solution) ↔ (IsGreatest {k | ∃ S, S ⊆ Icc 1 16 ∧ conspiratorial S ∧ S.encard = k} putnam_1974_a1_solution))
probe.proof:
by
  let T : Set ℤ := ↑(Finset.Icc (6 : ℤ) 16)
  refine ⟨fun S => S = T, ?_⟩
  have hcard : T.encard = putnam_1974_a1_solution := by
    norm_num [T, Finset.card_Icc, putnam_1974_a1_solution]
  have hsub : T ⊆ Icc (1 : ℤ) 16 := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [T, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_Icc] at hx
    exact ⟨by omega, hx.2⟩
  have hright : IsGreatest {k | ∃ S, S ⊆ Icc 1 16 ∧ S = T ∧ S.encard = k} putnam_1974_a1_solution := by
    constructor
    · exact ⟨T, hsub, rfl, hcard⟩
    · intro k hk
      rcases hk with ⟨S, _, rfl, hk⟩
      exact le_of_eq (hk.symm.trans hcard)
  intro h
  rcases (h.mpr hright).1 with ⟨S, hsub', hS, _⟩
  have hmem : (16 : ℤ) ∈ S := by
    rw [hS]
    simp [T]
  have hbad := hsub' hmem
  norm_num at hbad
